goal: Validate physics-based candidate selection for planar object interaction in MuJoCo.
active_hypotheses: Fresh-state MuJoCo candidate rollouts can improve first-attempt physical task selection.
Open-loop force plans will degrade under mass and friction variation.
unresolved_questions: Should feedback control or online system identification be introduced first?
What variation range should define robust v1 success?
How should rotate be evaluated independently from translation?
next_gate: Randomize mass and friction, measure first-attempt success, and compare open-loop selection with feedback.
